skill.name: specdd-refactor
skill.description: Guides SpecDD-aware refactoring for code, tests, documentation, specs, and project structure while preserving specified behavior.
skill.summary: Refactor SpecDD projects while preserving active specifications, write authority, and public behavior.

content.value_statement: Spec-driven projects can lose behavior during large structural changes. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through SpecDD-aware refactoring with authority checks and verification.
actual_capabilities: Checks that a project already has a root .specdd/bootstrap.md before use.
Defines the bootstrap file reading order for active SpecDD project rules.
Guides spec chain resolution before planning, editing, reviewing, testing, or reporting.
Requires write authority before files are moved or changed.
Encourages baseline checks before refactoring and repeated checks afterward.
Preserves public contracts, dependencies, paths, and behavior defined by active specs.
limitations: It is intended only for projects that already use SpecDD.
It does not provide automated refactoring scripts or executable tools.
It depends on accurate bootstrap and spec files in the target repository.
It does not authorize behavior changes without separate SpecDD authority.

use_cases.title: Restructure a SpecDD module
use_cases.description: Plan a module move while preserving contracts, dependencies, tests, and governing specs.

use_cases.title: Review refactor authority
use_cases.description: Confirm which specs permit edits before changing files across project boundaries.

use_cases.title: Align docs and tests after structure changes
use_cases.description: Update related specs, documentation, and tests only when structure changes require it.

prompt_templates.title: Start a safe refactor
prompt_templates.scenario: Begin with a small SpecDD refactor.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use specdd-refactor for this SpecDD project. Identify the target files, governing specs, write authority, and baseline checks before editing.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a module move
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a refactor plan for moving this module. Preserve specified behavior, public paths, dependencies, and test coverage.

prompt_templates.title: Audit an in-progress refactor
prompt_templates.scenario: Check refactor work before final changes.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these refactor changes against the active SpecDD chain. List contract risks, missing verification, and files needing spec authority.

prompt_templates.title: Coordinate a complex structural change
prompt_templates.scenario: Handle a multi-file refactor across boundaries.
prompt_templates.prompt: Resolve all governing specs for this structural change. Separate pure refactor steps from behavior changes and propose verification for each step.

output_examples.input: A request to move a service into a new package inside an existing SpecDD project.
output_examples.output: The assistant reports the active bootstrap chain, governing specs, write authority, baseline checks, and a behavior-preserving move plan.

output_examples.input: A refactor diff that changes tests, documentation, and module paths.
output_examples.output: The assistant identifies which changes are structural, which specs authorize them, and which verification steps remain.

output_examples.input: A request that requires a behavior change during a planned refactor.
output_examples.output: The assistant stops treating the task as pure refactoring and asks for authority covering the behavior change.

best_practices: Confirm the active bootstrap chain before planning edits.
Verify write authority for every moved or changed file.
Run practical baseline checks before and after risky refactor steps.
anti_patterns: Using the skill in a project without a root .specdd/bootstrap.md file.
Changing public behavior while describing the work as only a refactor.
Moving responsibility across spec boundaries without explicit authority.

faq.question: Does this skill perform automatic refactoring?
faq.answer: No. It provides a disciplined workflow for AI-assisted refactoring in SpecDD projects.

faq.question: Can I use it outside a SpecDD project?
faq.answer: No. The skill says to use it only when a root .specdd/bootstrap.md file exists.

faq.question: Which AI tools does it support?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it allow behavior changes?
faq.answer: Not as pure refactoring. Behavior changes require separate authority from the active specs or the user request.

faq.question: How does it reduce refactor risk?
faq.answer: It requires spec chain resolution, write authority, baseline checks, and preservation of specified contracts.

faq.question: Does it require network access?
faq.answer: No. The skill is documentation guidance and contains no network access instructions.
